summary.headline: Feature update reporting focuses on deployment status
summary.summary: Feature update reporting guidance now describes integrated deployment-status reports without repeating data-collection prerequisites, report-only data scope, or latency material.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm report prerequisites through the current requirements guidance before relying on feature update deployment status.

summary.headline: Update ring report image uses the current Windows updates view
summary.summary: The Update rings report illustration now points to the current update-rings image asset.
summary.adminImpact: No reporting behavior changes; administrators should use the current Windows updates experience.

summary.headline: Update ring illustration uses the current Windows updates view
summary.summary: The Update rings guidance now displays the current update-rings image asset.

summary.headline: Driver update reports are organized into Summary, Updates, and Failures tabs
summary.summary: Driver reporting guidance presents Driver updates summary, Driver updates, and Update failures as tabbed views; the driver view continues to show applicable policies for a selected driver across policies.
summary.adminImpact: Use the appropriate report tab to investigate fleet summary, a specific driver, or deployment failures.

summary.headline: Feature update reports include the shared admin-center link definition
summary.summary: Feature update reporting content includes the shared Intune admin center link definition used by its navigation guidance.
summary.adminImpact: No feature update reporting behavior changes.
